vocational_contracts.name: Forgekeeper
vocational_contracts.short: Inspect two ore samples → choose a vein or salvage cache → gather → forge a fitting for the road crew.
vocational_contracts.expedition: Follow a damaged caravan route, fight or bypass a sentry camp, recover a stamped salvage plate and choose between a safer common vein and a dangerous high-grade seam. Return to forge and contribute a reinforced fitting.
vocational_contracts.choice: Use a durable alloy for a road support or a lighter alloy for a personal equipment upgrade. The recipe previews tradeoffs before materials are committed.
vocational_contracts.mastery: Recover the three annotated forge plans along the frontier route, prove several alloy choices and complete the reinforced-watchtower contract. Advanced plans improve controllable outcomes, not access to mandatory story gear.
vocational_contracts.calm: Evaluate ore, buy a permitted salvage substitute from the quartermaster and complete a workshop/repair contract without an ambush.
vocational_contracts.combat: Make and repair combat equipment, defend supply expeditions and interpret armor weaknesses from salvaged fittings.
vocational_contracts.world: Fittings, defense repairs, recovery of plans and a verified caravan defense can satisfy distinct project objectives.
vocational_contracts.failure: Wrong ore grade rejects before craft; an exhausted vein offers another authored source. Tool wear occurs with the committed harvest, and a disconnection queries that receipt rather than refunding twice.
skills: Evaluate: identify grade and likely impurity before committing a route.
Fabricate: choose approved alloy/weight tradeoffs at the forge.
Restore: repair authored defense stages using materials or recovery achievements.

vocational_contracts.name: Hearthkeeper
vocational_contracts.short: Select a safe fishing spot → catch one Reedfin → harvest Goldenroot → bake FieldLoaf and provision an expedition.
vocational_contracts.expedition: Investigate a changed fish habitat, obtain a seasonal ingredient through an accessible in-game window or substitute, choose a menu and accompany or prepare a caravan.
vocational_contracts.choice: Prepare travel-endurance rations or recovery food based on the route’s danger and weather. The menu affects a bounded authored preparation benefit.
vocational_contracts.mastery: Complete regional menus, restore a town garden and organize the settlement’s optional harvest gathering. No calendar attendance is mandatory for profession mastery.
vocational_contracts.calm: Fish in accessible mode, tend the private garden and provision NPC volunteers rather than personally fighting the caravan encounter.
vocational_contracts.combat: Food supports expedition preparation and recovery; a Hearthkeeper may independently be a Vanguard, Ranger, Arcanist or Warden.
vocational_contracts.world: Supply meals, recover damaged fields, identify fish habitats and complete provisioning objectives, not interchangeable currency donations alone.
vocational_contracts.failure: Escaped fish ends that CastId without a grant. Full bags preserve the mature crop or pending catch policy. Crops do not die simply because the player was offline.
skills: Read the Water: interpret authored species/habitat clues.
Grow: choose soil/crop outcomes without compulsory repeated watering.
Provision: choose menus and approved ingredient substitutions.

vocational_contracts.name: Wayfinder
vocational_contracts.short: Read tracks → choose a safe or direct path → inspect a landmark → report a useful route to the village.
vocational_contracts.expedition: Follow three authored clues into Elderwood, find a hostile camp, overcome a skirmish or complete a slower investigation and map Willow Cut.
vocational_contracts.choice: Reveal a safer supply route or prioritize a high-risk reconnaissance lead. Personal knowledge and public route access are credited separately.
vocational_contracts.mastery: Compile the six-region field atlas, resolve route clues and complete a regional legendary-hunt investigation. Later arrivals can still earn every critical personal discovery.
vocational_contracts.calm: Map known-safe paths, interpret landmarks and report trail conditions without fighting the most dangerous camp.
vocational_contracts.combat: Scout threats, expose lairs and prepare encounters. Combat rewards follow the common discipline/participation rules, not a special scout-only XP ledger.
vocational_contracts.world: Discover routes, locate resource pockets, deliver authorized threat reports and enable new patrol/merchant options.
vocational_contracts.failure: Wrong clue order explains the missing lead; a public shortcut does not retroactively award personal discovery. Reentry cannot replay a discovery reward.
skills: Observe: interpret clue categories and tracks.
Navigate: compare authored route cost, danger and water access.
Report: publish permitted map information and regional threat evidence.
vocational_contracts.material: Three valid clues → personal discovery receipt + eligible shared-route report

vocational_contracts.name: Woodwright
vocational_contracts.mentor: Orris Vale, grove and bridge steward
vocational_contracts.short: Assess an eligible mature stand → select timber → craft a support → restore a grove or reinforce a roadside structure.
vocational_contracts.expedition: Investigate a corrupted grove, collect appropriate timber, choose bridge or defensive supports and protect a restoration crew through a bounded encounter.
vocational_contracts.choice: Select straight-grain timber for structural reliability or flexible wood for an authored bow/trap recipe. Restoration decisions preserve a viable future resource site.
vocational_contracts.mastery: Recover regional joinery patterns, restore authored groves and complete the ridge-watch construction sequence. Do not require unrestricted terrain editing.
vocational_contracts.calm: Assess and harvest an approved mature stand, craft furniture/supports and restore a designated grove stage without a defense encounter.
vocational_contracts.combat: Create bows, traps and defensive supports; join forest-route protection. Traps use normal authoritative encounter/loot credit.
vocational_contracts.world: Bridge timbers, watchpost supports, grove restoration and route defense are distinct accepted contribution types.
vocational_contracts.failure: Protected saplings cannot be harvested; shared restoration permissions prevent a rival overwriting progress. Replanting is an authored state change, not a real-time ecosystem simulation.
skills: Assess: recognize usable grades and protected stands.
Restore: recover bounded groves and fortify eligible road projects.
vocational_contracts.material: Reviewed timber grade + approved fittings → BridgeSupport; exact timber item catalog remains to author

vocational_contracts.name: Apothecary
vocational_contracts.short: Identify a fictional plant condition → select a safe collection site → prepare a remedy → help a field team or affected grove.
vocational_contracts.expedition: Trace a local blight through environmental clues, collect a reagent on a risky or safer route, choose an approved formula and treat an authored regional condition.
vocational_contracts.choice: Choose a stabilizing remedy or an expedition antidote from a published fictional recipe. Wrong research/ingredient combinations fail before any irreversible unpreviewed debit.
vocational_contracts.mastery: Complete the regional research folio, unlock bounded formula variations and resolve each authored affliction route. No real medical claims or actual herb recipes belong in this game system.
vocational_contracts.calm: Study safe specimens and commission permitted missing common supplies, then prepare support remedies without entering the hardest combat site.
vocational_contracts.combat: Prepare approved healing/support consumables and expose authored enemy/environment weaknesses. A separate combat discipline supplies the player’s direct abilities.
vocational_contracts.world: Research receipts, field remedies, recovered specimens and curative project objectives support a region without another specialist being online.
vocational_contracts.failure: An unknown reagent or incomplete research produces an explicit prerequisite error. Repeated cure delivery cannot reduce danger or award mastery twice. Missing alchemy poses use a declared temporary interaction animation.
skills: Identify: distinguish authored fictional specimen clues.
Aid: apply support preparations and resolve validated curative objectives.
vocational_contracts.material: Reviewed BlightReagent recipe → BlightRemedy; complete quantities and balancing remain to author
